question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**consequence**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses earthquakes and their causes, as well as their consequences.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate something that follows from an event, which fits the context of volcanic activity leading to earthquakes.
 
• **"Consequence"** fits well as it denotes something that follows or results from an action, which aligns with how volcanic activity can lead to earthquakes.
 
• Other options such as "name," "classification," and "direction" do not fit the context of something resulting from volcanic activity.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Name"** refers to the designation of something, but it does not convey the meaning of an outcome following volcanic activity.
 
• **"Classification"** refers to categorizing something, which does not match the context of results or consequences.
 
• **"Direction"** refers to the orientation or course of something, but it does not fit the cause-effect relationship described in the passage.
